CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
April 14, 2020 –
6:15
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

CONSENT CALENDAR
6.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of March 10, 2020, the regular meeting of March 10, 2020, and the Emergency Meeting of March 16, 2020.
6.1 Minutes of March 10, 2020 Study Session
6.1 Minutes of March 10, 2020 Council Meeting
6.1 Minutes of March 16, 2020 Emergency Meeting
6.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated April 14, 2020 in the total amount of $4,063,999.10.
6.2 Warrant Register
6.3
SR-91/I-605/I-405 CONGESTION PROJECT HOT SPOTS (I-605 MITIGATION PROJECT) – GENERAL ASSIGNMENT AND ASSUMPTION AGREEMENT WITH CITY OF SANTA FE SPRINGS FOR A PORTION OF PROPERTY AND TEMPORARY CONSTRUCTION EASEMENT AT 14207 ROSECRANS AVENUE - It is recommended the City Council approve and authorize the Mayor to execute the General Assignment and Assumption Agreement and authorize the Mayor to sign the certificate of acceptance for the grant deed and the temporary construction easement upon close of escrow.
6.3 Agreement with the City of Santa Fe Springs
6.4
SR-91/I-605/I-405 CONGESTION PROJECT HOT SPOTS (I-605 MITIGATION PROJECT) – AGREEMENT FOR LEGAL SERVICES FOR LAND ACQUISITON BY EMINENT DOMAIN BETWEEN THE CITY OF LA MIRADA, CITY OF SANTA FE SPRINGS AND JONES & MAYER, FOR A PORTION OF PROPERTY AND TEMPORARY CONSTRUCTION EASEMENT AT 15910 VALLEY VIEW AVENUE - It is recommended the City Council approve and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement for legal services for land acquisition by eminent domain between the City of La Mirada, City of Santa Fe Springs and Jones & Mayer, for a portion of property and temporary construction easement at 15910 Valley View Avenue.
6.4 Agreement for Legal Services and Land Acquisition
7.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
7.1
RESOLUTION NO. 20-09 RECOGNIZING THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA GOVERNOR'S OFFICE OF EMERGENCY SERVICES, FORM 130 FOR DESIGNATION OF AUTHORIZED AGENTS FOR NON-STATE AGENCIES - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-09 recognizing the State of California Governor's Office of Emergency Services, Form 130 for designation of authorized agents for non-state agencies.
7.1 Resolution No. 20-09
7.2
RESOLUTION NO. 20-10 EXTENDING THE CLOSURE OF LA MIRADA CITY FACILITIES UNTIL THE DATE WHEN THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY STAY AT HOME ORDER NO LONGER IS IN EFFECT - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-10 extending the closure of La Mirada City facilities until the date when the Los Angeles County Stay at Home Order no longer is in effect.
7.2 Resolution No. 20-10
8.
SPECIAL ITEMS
8.1.
RESOLUTION NO. 20-11 RECITING THE FACTS OF THE GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION HELD ON MARCH 3, 2020 AND DECLARING THE RESULTS AND SUCH OTHER MATTERS AS PROVIDED BY LAW - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-11 reciting that the General Municipal Election was held March 3, 2020 and declaring the results.
8.1 Resolution No. 20-11
8.2.
OATH OF OFFICE ADMINISTERED TO NEWLY ELECTED COUNCILMEMBERS – It is recommended the City Clerk administer the Oath of Office to Steve De Ruse, Ed Eng, and Anthony Otero.
8.3.
CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION – It is recommended the City Clerk initiate the procedure for reorganization of City Council.
8.3 City Council Reorganization
